title: Higher-order asymptotic formulae for periodic orbits of 3-dimensional volume-preserving Anosov flows and the Foulon conjecture
summary: Let $X^t$ be a volume-preserving Anosov flow of class $C^7$ on a closed $3$-manifold. We consider a sequence of periodic orbits which shadow a homoclinic loop of a fixed periodic orbit $γ$, and derive higher-order asymptotic expansions for their periods $T_n$ and for the logarithms of their unstable multipliers $\logλ_n$. We give geometric interpretations of the coefficients in these expansions, in particular in terms of the Anosov cocycle (à la Hurder-Katok) and the longitudinal Anosov cocycle (à la Foulon-Hasselblatt), evaluated on $γ$.
